newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume jumps on demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed, volume jumps on demand.

text.p: Volume jumped on Istanbul's gold exchange on Thursday on fresh free market demand buoyed by lower prices in international markets and a weak Turkish lira, dealers said.
Traded volume was 1,065 kilos, up from 740 yesterday.
Gold closed lower at $373.00 an ounce after Wednesday's $374.20. But it leapt to 1,220,600 lira per gram from 1,217,500 due to the lira's weakness in the currency market.
The lira fell sharply to 101,850 against the dollar from 101,080 on Wednesday due to a strong dollar/mark parity.

"Lower ounce prices and a higher dollar created free market demand aimed at swapping (gold and currency positions). There were also purchases to lower average carrying costs of gold by those who bought at higher prices earlier in the week," said one dealer.
Morning trade totalled 825 kilos with 240 kilos done in the afternoon and 94.3 percent of the volume was in dollar terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
